title: Cardiac Surgery Multi-Agent RAG Assistant
summary: A Streamlit assistant for pre-op, intra-op, and post-op surgical workflows, using retrieval and dynamic agents for patient and stent recommendations.
highlights: Created a ChromaDB vector database for cardiac surgery knowledge retrieval.
Designed agent flows for personalized patient context and recommendation logic.
Collaborated with physicians during validation and clinical testing.
impact: Clinical workflow support for high-context surgical decisions.

title: CV Management Application with LLMs
summary: A modular CV creation tool that adapts resumes to job offers with LLMs and exports ATS-friendly PDFs.
highlights: Integrated OpenAI and GPT-OSS-20B models through Groq API workflows.
Generated professional PDF exports with ReportLab.
Built a reusable editing flow for fast resume iteration.
impact: A practical career tool for targeted application material.

title: Personalized Nutrition Recommendation System
summary: An adaptive recommendation system for meal plans using nutritional data, reinforcement learning, and evolutionary optimization.
highlights: Structured nutritional data for more than 200 meals.
Implemented Q-learning and genetic algorithms for meal selection under constraints.
Added preference feedback loops for allergies, dietary choices, and macronutrient targets.
impact: Personalized meal suggestions that adapt to user constraints.

title: IMA 205 Cardiac MRI Diagnosis
summary: A competition-winning cardiac MRI diagnosis pipeline with segmentation, radiomics extraction, and ensemble classification.
highlights: Applied U-Net, SegNet, and Segment Anything Model for cardiac structure segmentation.
Extracted more than 100 radiomics features with PyRadiomics.
Combined LightGBM, XGBoost, and Autoencoder-SVM models through stacking.
impact: 1st place among 100 participants, with 95% train and 81% validation accuracy.

title: NASA Algal Bloom Detection
summary: A satellite imagery pipeline for harmful algal bloom detection using multi-spectral data and optimized gradient boosting.
highlights: Processed Sentinel-2 and Landsat imagery across diverse geographic regions.
Engineered spectral and temporal features for bloom prediction.
Optimized LightGBM hyperparameters with Optuna.
impact: Ranked 50th out of 1,377 participants with an AggRMSE of 1.0536.

title: Embedded Gait Analysis on Edge Devices
summary: An embedded gait analysis system using IMU sensors and deep learning for knee angle prediction.
highlights: Connected Arduino Nano 33 IoT with MPU-9250 IMU sensors for motion capture.
Built denoising autoencoders to improve signal quality by roughly 20%.
Compared GRU, LSTM, and Transformer models for time series prediction.
impact: Edge-ready AI for rehabilitation, sports biomechanics, and bionic leg control.

title: FinOps Multi-Agent Assistant
summary: A LangGraph assistant for cloud cost analysis, budget planning, and optimization recommendations.
highlights: Built modular agents for cost analysis and recommendation tasks.
Maintained context across long financial conversations with custom memory handling.
Deployed serverless components through AWS Lambda, S3, and Bedrock.
impact: Reduced API costs by 30% through prompt optimization and caching strategies.
